title: Special forces guys play 'Hunter Skinwalker' at the ranch

tellings.quote: these three guys, the armed guys, the special forces guys that went on there and they were going to play, you know, Hunter Skinwalker

plain: Three armed former special forces men went onto Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange happenings, planning to play "Hunter Skinwalker" and hunt whatever was there. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron tells it as he heard it from Brandon Fugal, the ranch's owner, without saying how it turned out.
